title: Coastal Cave - Expedition 33 Area Guide (Bosses, Loot & Tips)
description: Coastal Cave in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - how to reach it, the bosses inside, the weapons and Pictos you can find, and what to watch out for.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A cave system on the coastline with a cluster of merchants and the Gobluson and Bourgelon weapons.

sections.title: How to Reach Coastal Cave
sections.content: Reached from the coastal edge of The Continent.
